prospect_summary: Onesixth Expeditions is a B Corp certified destination management company for Argentina, with teams in London and Buenos Aires. It designs tailor-made, conservation-driven journeys that go beyond the standard circuit - the glaciers and steppe of Patagonia, the remote high desert of La Puna and the Andes, estancia life, and the culture of Buenos Aires - for discerning, conscious travellers. The business is roughly 95 percent DMC work: it does not sell to consumers in source markets, it delivers the ground for outbound operators who do. Onesixth positions itself as the most sustainable DMC in Argentina, tracking carbon footprint and reporting it back to trade clients, donating 1 percent of profits through 1% for the Planet, and is a LATA member. The ideal partners are outbound operators and travel designers in the UK and US selling Argentina, Patagonia or wider South America who want a reliable, sustainability-credentialled Argentine ground partner.
